name: sage-memory
description: Captures and recalls durable context for AI agents — architecture decisions, user preferences, debugging insights, conventions, anything worth remembering across sessions. Teaches the agent when to remember (store findings during work), when to recall (search memory at session start and task start), and how to learn (structured knowledge capture via sage learn). Use when the user mentions memory, remember, recall, learn, capture knowledge, onboard to codebase, or when starting any session where sage-memory MCP tools are available.
